module.label: at module top level
module.guidance: Script code, not an Effect program. If the file is tooling, declare it hostTooling and rescan; otherwise move the statement into a program run at the edge (NodeRuntime.runMain or an executableEdges entry), then rewrite it as below.

function.label: in plain functions
function.guidance: The enclosing function is not Effect code yet. Convert it (Effect.fn / Effect.gen; an async one is reported by EFF002/EFF003) — or, if it is a platform callback, keep it as a terminal adapter that runs an Effect program — then rewrite this hit as below.

effect.label: in Effect programs
effect.guidance: Inside an Effect program: rewrite in place.

boundary.label: in boundary callbacks
boundary.guidance: Inside an Effect.promise/tryPromise/sync/try callback, Promise or synchronous code by design: let the boundary map the failure (catch: (cause) => new XError({ cause })) instead of rewriting the callback body.

rules.name: raw-try-catch
rules.message: Native try/catch is forbidden. Wrap the side effect in Effect.try / Effect.tryPromise; type the failure channel with a Schema.TaggedError.

help.after: Effect.try({ try: () => JSON.parse(text), catch: (cause) => new ParseError({ cause }) })

coverage.proves: No try statement in the scanned files (except inside Effect.promise/tryPromise callbacks and non-async Effect.sync/try callbacks; the boundary is a lexical region: functions nested in a callback inherit its boundary, and the innermost boundary decides)
blindSpots: Promise .catch()/.then() error handling is not checked

A file that does not parse yields no runner facts; it is reported as EFF504 only

rules.name: typescript-compile-error
rules.message: TypeScript reported a compile error; code that does not compile against the installed Effect version is not compliant.

coverage.proves: Scanned files in the program compile under the project tsconfig; a file the scanner itself cannot parse (a syntax error) is reported per file and never silently yields an empty verdict
blindSpots: Files outside the tsconfig program, declaration files under skipLibCheck, and errors suppressed by ts-expect-error/ts-ignore are not reported

rules.name: invalid-manifest
rules.message: .effect-skill.json failed schema validation or declares a stale entry (nativeDependencyBoundaries, or an allowedAdapters/aiProviderTransports/hostTooling selector that matches no file).

rules.name: missing-tsc
rules.message: --strict requires a project-local TypeScript compiler.

rules.name: missing-effect-diagnostics-provider
rules.message: --strict requires the Effect diagnostics provider matching the installed TypeScript major.

rules.name: empty-shape
rules.message: --strict requires a non-empty package shape.

rules.name: invalid-runtime-fact-source
rules.message: Declared runtime fact source could not be read as supported facts.

rules.name: ambiguous-worker-shape
rules.message: shape worker is ambiguous without a declared runtime fact source such as wranglerPath.

rules.name: workspace-owner-outside-workspace
rules.message: dependencyOwner workspace-root requires the scan target to be a declared workspace package.

rules.name: unsupported-effect-version
rules.message: Effect must satisfy the supported v4 range.

rules.name: suppression-drift
rules.message: eff-ignore comment is invalid: it needs reason="...", must match a finding of its rule on its line, and must not be expired

coverage.proves: Every eff-ignore comment carries a reason; with --fail-on-suppression-drift each also matches a finding of its rule still on its line and is not expired
blindSpots: Whether the reason holds is not judged; it is only checked to be non-empty
Without --fail-on-suppression-drift, orphaned and expired comments are not reported
